definitions: To harbor resentment or ill will towards someone.
To be determined to cause trouble or harm to someone.
examples: She's always had it out for him since the promotion.
I think the boss has it out for me; he's always criticizing my work.
They've had it out for each other for years over that old dispute.
lemma: to have it out for someone
synonyms: to hold a grudge against someone
to be out to get someone
to have it in for someone
source: to have it out for someone
